source: If you want me to be even more honest, I believe the overall management is what troubles me the most.
translation: 如果要我更坦白一点，我认为整体管理才是最令我担忧的。

source: As you may have noticed from our meeting earlier, the issues I pointed out were all due to subpar leadership.
translation: 从刚才的会议中你可能已经注意到，我指出的问题都源于领导不力。

source: Even though every department had its own shortcomings, when the ship sinks, the captain is to blame after all.
translation: 虽然每个部门都有各自的缺点，但船沉时终究要由船长负责。

source: I don’t think there’s anything wrong with the way Sir Goro has been leading the project so far… Are you sure you’re just not looking too much into it?
translation: 我不认为Goro先生目前领导项目的方式有什么问题……你确定不是想得太严重了吗？

source: Especially since we’re talking about something as serious as the one who holds this place together.
translation: 尤其我们谈论的，还是支撑整个营地的那个人。

source: It’s about time this camp let go of its outdated ways and let the new generation take over.
translation: 这座营地早该摒弃过时的做法，让新一代接手了。

source: Starting tomorrow, you and I will be in charge of both technology and overall management.
translation: 从明天开始，你和我会共同负责技术与整体管理。

source: A-Are you saying we would take over Sir Goro’s position? We can’t do that!
translation: 你、你是说我们要接管Goro先生的职位？我们不能这么做！

source: No, no, we just need to work together and be Mr. Nomoru’s advisors – to ensure we provide more 'modern' insights about how this camp and project should be run.
translation: 不，不，我们只需要合作担任Nomoru先生的顾问——确保为营地和项目的运营提供更“现代”的见解。

source: I’m sure you can agree that changes are inevitable. Refusing to adapt will eventually doom this camp.
translation: 相信你也同意，变化不可避免。拒绝适应最终会毁掉这座营地。

source: Let me emphasize this one last time, though, since you don't seem to be getting it.
translation: 不过你似乎还没明白，让我最后再强调一次。

source: I guess that’s my cue to hit the hay for now…
translation: 看来我也该上床睡觉了……

source: I have to get up earlier than usual and meal prep or we might get called out for being late again.
translation: 我得比平时更早起床准备餐点，否则我们可能又会因为迟到被批评。

source: See? ~ New beginnings!
translation: 看吧？～新的开始！

source: That’s a generic phrase, Lloyd.
translation: 那只是一句泛泛之谈，Lloyd。

source: Hmph, then tell me how it completely explains the coincidences!
translation: 哼，那你解释一下，为什么它能完全说明这些巧合！

source: Anyway, we’ll be heading to sleep too!
translation: 总之，我们也要去睡觉了！

source: Are you sure it’s alright for you to share a bed with Darius?
translation: 你确定和Darius共用一张床没问题吗？

source: Alright then! Good night, you guys~!
translation: 那好吧！晚安，各位～！

source: Now, do you mind telling me why you’re acting strangely again, Yoshinori?
translation: 现在，能告诉我你为什么又表现得这么奇怪吗，Yoshinori？

source: Emilia didn’t say anything else back there to you, did she?
translation: Emilia刚才没有再对你说别的吧？

source: W-Well… She did, and it really gave me something to think about.
translation: 这、这个……她说了，而且确实给了我一些需要思考的事。

source: If you’d like, I could reach out to Mr. Clermont and make some arrangements for a different inspector…
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以联系Clermont先生，安排更换检查员……

source: O-Oh, no sir, please you don’t have to do that…
translation: 哦、哦，不，先生，请不要这么做……

source: Actually, for some reason, Emilia was trying to help clear up my role on this project.
translation: 其实不知为何，Emilia想帮助我明确自己在这个项目中的职责。

source: That has been on your mind for the past week.
translation: 过去一周，你一直在为这件事烦恼。

source: Yes, sir… She actually offered to work directly with me, too. But I didn’t give her an answer just yet.
translation: 是的，先生……她还主动提出直接与我合作。但我还没有给她答案。

source: I think she genuinely wants to help me out, but that evaluation a while ago really seemed unnecessarily harsh.
translation: 我觉得她是真心想帮我，但刚才那场评估似乎严厉得没有必要。

source: Yes. She was rather strict and straightforward with her opinions. It kind of reminded me of how I was, and not in a good way.
translation: 是的。她表达意见时相当严厉、直接。这让我想起了过去的自己，而且不是好的一面。

source: I don’t deny that I have flaws in my leadership… perhaps this project is a good opportunity for me to correct those.
translation: 我不否认自己的领导方式存在缺陷……也许这个项目正是改正它们的好机会。

source: That actually had me thinking, sir… If she had issues with the management, shouldn’t she have offered to work with you instead?
translation: 这其实让我想到一件事，先生……如果她对管理有意见，不是更应该主动与您合作吗？

source: It seems Ms. Komarova is quite fond of you. She had a different tone when talking with you.
translation: Komarova女士似乎很喜欢你。和你说话时，她的语气完全不同。

source: I figured maybe since you two were past acquaintances, it had something to do with that.
translation: 我想也许是因为你们过去相识，所以才会如此。

source: Yes, sir… I did notice that as well.
translation: 是的，先生……我也注意到了。

source: And that’s why I held back on her offer in the first place.
translation: 所以我一开始才没有接受她的提议。

source: You should work with me instead then.
translation: 那么你应该改为和我一起工作。

source: Knowing what’s been going on in your mind since the start of this project, it only makes sense that I take you under my wing.
translation: 既然知道项目开始以来你一直在想什么，由我亲自指导你才最合理。

source: With us working side by side, I can make sure to guide you every step of the way.
translation: 只要我们并肩工作，我就能确保在每一步都引导你。

source: I-I was thinking the same thing, sir…! After all, I realized I’m at my best when I’m working with you.
translation: 我、我也是这么想的，先生……！毕竟我意识到，与您一起工作时才是我状态最好的时候。

source: Exactly.
translation: 正是如此。

source: And more importantly, we can use this chance to further train you in the tasks and responsibilities of someone who will take over the camp one day.
translation: 更重要的是，我们可以借此机会进一步训练你，让你掌握未来接管营地之人应承担的任务和责任。

source: Ah… Well, I really don’t think I’m ready for that, sir…
translation: 啊……这个嘛，我真的觉得自己还没有准备好，先生……

source: You can learn as we go, I’m here to help after all.
translation: 你可以边做边学，毕竟我会在这里帮助你。

source: Thank you so much for this opportunity, sir. It really cleared my mind about what my role in this project really is!
translation: 非常感谢您给我这个机会，先生。它真的让我明确了自己在项目中的职责！

source: It’s my pleasure.
translation: 这是我的荣幸。

source: Anyways, I’ll let Ms. Komarova know as soon as possible that you will be declining her offer.
translation: 总之，我会尽快通知Komarova女士，你将拒绝她的提议。

source: I-It’s alright, sir! I can do it! I’m sure I can find a way to tell her as professionally as possible. What’s more important to me right now is the work we’ll do together.
translation: 没、没关系，先生！我可以自己说！我相信能以尽可能专业的方式告诉她。现在对我更重要的是我们将共同完成的工作。

source: Hehe…
translation: 嘿嘿……

source: I have to say, sir… I’m actually glad that you’re moving in here with us.
translation: 我得说，先生……您搬来和我们一起住，其实让我很高兴。

source: Well, either way, I did plan to move in here at some point to get closer with you guys…
translation: 其实无论如何，我原本就打算找机会搬来，更亲近你们……

source: That, or I was going to invite you to start staying over in my room to give the staff here more space.
translation: 不然我就会邀请你到我的房间过夜，为这里的员工腾出更多空间。

source: A-Ah…! Really?
translation: 啊、啊……！真的吗？

source: Yes. But with how busy we’ve all been, I never had the chance.
translation: 是的。不过大家一直都很忙，我始终没有机会。

source: I guess Emilia’s stay here gave me a good push to actually do it.
translation: 我想Emilia留下来，正好推动我真正付诸行动。

source: Well, that’s a good way to look at it, sir!
translation: 这样看确实很好，先生！

source: All we have to do is to keep at it and stay true to the goals we have.
translation: 我们只要坚持下去，忠于共同的目标。

source: Yes, sir! I’ll do my best and stay by your side throughout the whole thing!
translation: 是，先生！我会尽最大努力，并在整个过程中陪在您身边！

source: Thanks, Yoshinori. Let’s get some sleep, it’ll be a busy day tomorrow.
translation: 谢谢你，Yoshinori。睡觉吧，明天会很忙。

source: Goodnight, sir!
translation: 晚安，先生！

source: Good night, Yoshinori.
translation: 晚安，Yoshinori。
